column1:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.

Winds will be North-easterly to northerly in the sea areas from Mullaittivu to Colombo via
Kankasanthurai and Puttalam. Winds will be South-westerly or variable in the other sea areas around
the island. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
